passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says: Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
God spoke to me.
God called me "son of man."
God told me to speak to the ruler of Tyre.
God said, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
God said, "Your heart is proud."
You said, "I am a god."
You said, "I sit in the seat of gods."
You said, "I sit in the heart of the sea."
But you are a man.
You are not a god.
You have made your heart like the heart of a god.
But you are only a man.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם אֱמֹר֩ לִנְגִ֨יד צֹ֜ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ל אָ֔נִי מוֹשַׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשַׁ֖בְתִּי בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּ֑ים וְאַתָּ֤ה אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ אֵ֔ל וַתִּתֵּ֥ן לִבְּךָ֖ כְּלֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you!
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the ruler of Tyre.
You are wise.
You are wiser than Daniel.
No secret is hidden from you.
You understand every mystery.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה חָכָ֛ם אַתָּ֖ה מִדָּנִאֵל כָּל־ סָת֖וּם לֹ֥א עֲמָמֽוּךָ׃

passages.text: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries.
passages.sermon:
You are the ruler of Tyre.
You have wisdom.
You have understanding.
You used your wisdom and understanding.
You gained wealth for yourself.
You gathered gold for your treasuries.
You gathered silver for your treasuries.
passages.original: בְּחָכְמָֽתְךָ֙ וּבִתְבוּנָ֣תְךָ֔ עָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ חָ֑יִל וַתַּ֛עַשׂ זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף בְּאוֹצְרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.
passages.sermon:
You have great wisdom.
You have great skill in trading.
You have used your skill to gain much wealth.
You have become rich because of your trading.
Your heart has become proud because of your wealth.
passages.original: בְּרֹ֧ב חָכְמָתְךָ֛ בִּרְכֻלָּתְךָ֖ הִרְבִּ֣יתָ חֵילֶ֑ךָ וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לְבָבְךָ֖ בְּחֵילֶֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god, behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and will defile your splendor.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He addresses the ruler of Tyre.
The ruler of Tyre has become proud.
He thinks his heart is like the heart of a god.
The Lord GOD responds to this pride.
He says, “Because you have set your heart as the heart of a god, I will act against you.”
The Lord GOD will bring foreigners against the ruler.
These foreigners are the most ruthless of nations.
They will attack with their swords.
They will strike at the beauty of the ruler’s wisdom.
They will defile the ruler’s splendor.
passages.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֛עַן תִּתְּךָ֥ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֖ כְּלֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים׃ לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ זָרִ֔ים עָרִיצֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֑ם וְהֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם֙ עַל־ יְפִ֣י חָכְמָתֶ֔ךָ וְחִלְּל֖וּ יִפְעָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners will attack you.
They will bring you down to the Pit.
You will die a violent death.
You will die in the heart of the seas.
passages.original: לַשַּׁ֖חַת יֽוֹרִד֑וּךָ וָמַ֛תָּה מְמוֹתֵ֥י חָלָ֖ל בְּלֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the king of Tyre.
The king of Tyre is proud.
He claims to be like a god.
Enemies will come to kill him.
Will the king say, "I am a god," when his killers stand before him?
He will not be a god then.
He will be only a man.
His enemies will wound him.
He will be in their hands.
He will not be a god in their hands.
He will be just a man.
passages.original: הֶאָמֹ֤ר תֹּאמַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אָ֔נִי לִפְנֵ֖י הֹֽרְגֶ֑ךָ וְאַתָּ֥ה אָדָ֛ם וְלֹא־ אֵ֖ל בְּיַ֥ד מְחַלְלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He says this to the king of Tyre.
You will die like the uncircumcised.
Foreigners will kill you.
I, the Lord GOD, have spoken.
passages.original: מוֹתֵ֧י עֲרֵלִ֛ים תָּמ֖וּת בְּיַד־ זָרִ֑ים כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
God spoke to me.
God called me "son of man."
God told me to take up a lament.
God told me to speak about the king of Tyre.
God told me to say what He says.
The Lord GOD says this to the king of Tyre.
You were the seal of perfection.
You were full of wisdom.
You were perfect in beauty.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שָׂ֥א קִינָ֖ה עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ צ֑וֹר וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אַתָּה֙ חוֹתֵ֣ם תָּכְנִ֔ית מָלֵ֥א חָכְמָ֖ה וּכְלִ֥יל יֹֽפִי׃

passages.text: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold, prepared on the day of your creation.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God spoke to the prophet Ezekiel about the king of Tyre.
The Lord described the king of Tyre.
You were in Eden.
Eden is the garden of God.
Every kind of precious stone covered you.
You had ruby.
You had topaz.
You had diamond.
You had beryl.
You had onyx.
You had jasper.
You had sapphire.
You had turquoise.
You had emerald.
Gold made your mountings and your settings.
People prepared these things for you on the day you were created.
passages.original: בְּעֵ֨דֶן גַּן־ אֱלֹהִ֜ים הָיִ֗יתָ כָּל־ אֶ֨בֶן יְקָרָ֤ה מְסֻכָתֶ֙ךָ֙ אֹ֣דֶם פִּטְדָ֞ה וְיָהֲלֹ֗ם תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֙הַם֙ וְיָ֣שְׁפֵ֔ה סַפִּ֣יר נֹ֔פֶךְ וּבָרְקַ֖ת וְזָהָ֑ב מְלֶ֨אכֶת תֻּפֶּ֤יךָ וּנְקָבֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּי֥וֹם הִבָּרַאֲךָ֖ כּוֹנָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the king of Tyre.
God described the king of Tyre as a guardian cherub.
God anointed the king of Tyre as a cherub who protects.
God appointed the king of Tyre to this role.
God placed the king of Tyre on His holy mountain.
The king of Tyre lived on the mountain of God.
The king of Tyre walked among fiery stones.
passages.original: אַ֨תְּ־ כְּר֔וּב מִמְשַׁ֖ח הַסּוֹכֵ֑ךְ וּנְתַתִּ֗יךָ בְּהַ֨ר קֹ֤דֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ הָיִ֔יתָ בְּת֥וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־ אֵ֖שׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃

passages.text: From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways— until wickedness was found in you.
passages.sermon:
God created you.
You were blameless from the beginning.
You lived without fault in all your ways.
This lasted from the day of your creation.
Then wickedness was found in you.
passages.original: תָּמִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בִּדְרָכֶ֔יךָ מִיּ֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָ֑ךְ עַד־ נִמְצָ֥א עַוְלָ֖תָה בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: By the vastness of your trade, you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I banished you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
passages.sermon:
You were a guardian cherub.
God appointed you to protect.
You traded with many.
Your trading became vast.
Violence filled you because of your trading.
You sinned.
God drove you away in disgrace from His holy mountain.
God banished you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
passages.original: בְּרֹ֣ב רְכֻלָּתְךָ֗ מָל֧וּ תוֹכְךָ֛ חָמָ֖ס וַֽתֶּחֱטָ֑א וָאֶחַלֶּלְךָ֩ מֵהַ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֤ים וָֽאַבֶּדְךָ֙ כְּר֣וּב הַסֹּכֵ֔ךְ מִתּ֖וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the guardian cherub.
You became proud because you were beautiful.
Your heart was lifted up by your beauty.
You ruined your wisdom because of your splendor.
I threw you down to the earth.
I put you in front of kings.
I made you a spectacle before them.
passages.original: גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ בְּיָפְיֶ֔ךָ שִׁחַ֥תָּ חָכְמָתְךָ֖ עַל־ יִפְעָתֶ֑ךָ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֗יךָ לִפְנֵ֧י מְלָכִ֛ים נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְרַ֥אֲוָה בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading you have profaned your sanctuaries. So I made fire come from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the guardian cherub.
You committed many sins.
You acted with dishonesty in your trading.
You profaned your sanctuaries.
I made fire come out from within you.
The fire consumed you.
I reduced you to ashes on the ground.
Everyone who saw you witnessed this.
passages.original: מֵרֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֶ֗יךָ בְּעֶ֙וֶל֙ רְכֻלָּ֣תְךָ֔ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑יךָ וָֽאוֹצִא־ אֵ֤שׁ מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ הִ֣יא אֲכָלַ֔תְךָ וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֤ לְאֵ֙פֶר֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ רֹאֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: All the nations who know you are appalled over you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ ”
passages.sermon:
All the nations know you.
These nations are appalled because of you.
You have reached a terrible end.
You will never exist again.
passages.original: כָּל־ יוֹדְעֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלֶ֑יךָ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְאֵינְךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to look toward Sidon.
He told me to speak a prophecy against Sidon.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ צִיד֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her and demonstrate My holiness through her.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to the prophet Ezekiel.
The Lord GOD gave a message about Sidon.
The Lord GOD said, “I am against you, Sidon.
I will show My glory inside you.
I will carry out judgments in Sidon.
I will show My holiness in Sidon.
The people will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן וְנִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בַּעֲשׂ֥וֹתִי בָ֛הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets; the slain will fall within her, while the sword is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Ezekiel.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said He will act against Sidon.
The LORD will send a plague into Sidon.
Blood will flow in Sidon's streets.
Many people will die inside Sidon.
Enemies will attack Sidon with the sword from every side.
The people will see these things.
They will know that the LORD is God.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ בָ֞הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָדָם֙ בְּח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְנִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖יהָ מִסָּבִ֑יב וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the people of Israel.
He promises to protect them.
Israel will not face a pricking brier again.
Israel will not face a painful thorn again.
No one around them will treat them with contempt anymore.
God will remove all those who hurt or despise Israel.
Then the people of Israel will know that He is the Lord GOD.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִכֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ם הַשָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will dwell in their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says these words.
He will gather the house of Israel.
The house of Israel is scattered among many peoples.
The Lord GOD will bring them back from those peoples.
He will show Himself holy among the house of Israel.
He will do this in the sight of all the nations.
The house of Israel will live in their own land.
The Lord GOD gave this land to His servant Jacob.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּקַבְּצִ֣י׀ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן־ הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔ם וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְיָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְעַבְדִּ֥י לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel will live in their land.
They will live there in safety.
They will build houses.
They will plant vineyards.
They will remain safe.
I, the LORD, will judge all those around them who treat them with contempt.
Then the people of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
passages.original: וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶיהָ֮ לָבֶטַח֒ וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְיָשְׁב֖וּ לָבֶ֑טַח בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֣י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּכֹ֨ל הַשָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָם֙ מִסְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ס
